designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Alligator River National Wildlife Refuge on land donated by the Prudential Insurance Company.

authority.citation: Donation of about 118,000 acres by Prudential Insurance Company accepted by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Alligator River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
USFWS, Alligator River NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2008), Refuge History: established March 1984 on land donated by Prudential
N.C. Department of Natural and Cultural Resources, "Wildlife Preserve on the Alligator River" (2016): established March 14, 1984

review.note: Established Mar. 14, 1984 by administrative action on a Prudential land donation.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1984 to protect the rare pocosin wetlands and their associated wildlife.
